figures.placement: after the closing responsibility paragraph in A Note on the Writing Process and AI Assistance
figures.visual_goal: Explain my iterative writing process: I set the concept, structure, core content, learning goals and visual direction; AI assists; I review, rewrite and decide what is published, repeating the process and retaining final editorial responsibility.
figures.prompt: Create one refined landscape 16:9 editorial process illustration for a nonfiction book about product and engineering leadership. Match a warm ivory paper background, crisp hand-drawn dark navy outlines, muted teal and ochre flat accents, generous whitespace, and simple physical objects, like the book's existing illustrated frameworks. No photorealism, gradients, futuristic effects, robot characters, stock-office scene, decorative title, logos or watermark. Show THREE clearly separated equal-width stations across the page, connected LEFT TO RIGHT by navy arrows. Exactly ONE large curved return arrow underneath goes FROM the third station BACK TO the first, making the repeated human-led cycle unmistakable. Leave clear space above the station headings; do not draw a return arrow or repeat any label at the top. At the right, a small branch from the third station leads down to an open book and a simple web-page window, representing publication after the author's decision. The loop must not look like an automatic approval gate. First station: heading exactly 'I SET DIRECTION'; draw a human hand with a pencil over an open notebook, a few chapter cards and a small color palette. Beneath the drawing print exactly three readable short lines: 'Concept & structure', 'Story & core content', 'Learning goals & visual style'. Second station: heading exactly 'AI SUPPORTS THE WORK'; draw a laptop and three clear paper outputs with icons for research, alternative drafts and an illustration, with a small code-bracket icon. Beneath print exactly three lines: 'Research & draft options', 'Illustrations & language', 'Consistency checks & scripts'. Third station: heading exactly 'I REVIEW AND DECIDE'; draw a human hand making pencil edits on pages beside a magnifying glass, with a few corrected marks. Beneath print exactly three lines: 'Select & rewrite', 'Check facts & numbers', 'My editorial responsibility'. Put the exact label 'REPEAT AND REFINE' above the bottom return arrow. Put the exact label 'BOOK + WEBSITE' beside the small publication objects. Use these labels only. Make every label large, sharp and legible at ordinary article width. Break long station headings over two lines as needed. Do not add any additional prose, tiny text, numbers, technical acronyms, approval stamps or fabricated claims. Human direction and human editorial responsibility must be visually as strong as the AI assistance station; AI is an essential supporting tool within the author's process.
figures.alt: Three stations show me setting direction, AI supporting research and production, and me reviewing and deciding. A return arrow marks repeated refinement; a book and website sit beside the review stage.
figures.caption: I set the direction, use AI to develop and check the work, then review and revise it through repeated iterations. The published book and website remain my editorial responsibility.
figures.revision_reason: Use first person for references to the book author, as requested on 2026-09-27.
figures.visual_review: Checked first-person labels, left-to-right stages, one return arrow, publication outputs and my editorial responsibility.
